python3 -c "
from scipy.stats import t
import numpy as np

gaps = np.array([-0.97, 1.45, -1.84])
margin = 2.0
n = 3
df = n - 1  # 2

mean = np.mean(gaps)
sd = np.std(gaps, ddof=1)
se = sd / np.sqrt(n)

# TOST
t_upper = (mean - margin) / se
t_lower = (mean - (-margin)) / se

p_upper = t.cdf(t_upper, df)
p_lower = 1 - t.cdf(t_lower, df)

tost_p = max(p_upper, p_lower)
equivalent = 'YES' if tost_p < 0.05 else 'NO'

print('=== Computation details ===')
print(f'gaps = {gaps.tolist()}')
print(f'mean = {mean:.4f} pp')
print(f'sd   = {sd:.4f} pp')
print(f'se   = {se:.4f} pp')
print(f'df   = {df}')
print()
print(f'Upper test: t_upper = ({mean:.4f} - {margin}) / {se:.4f} = {t_upper:.4f}')
print(f'  p_upper = P(T < {t_upper:.4f} | df={df}) = {p_upper:.6f}')
print()
print(f'Lower test: t_lower = ({mean:.4f} - ({-margin})) / {se:.4f} = {t_lower:.4f}')
print(f'  p_lower = 1 - P(T < {t_lower:.4f} | df={df}) = {p_lower:.6f}')
print()
print(f'tost_p = max({p_upper:.6f}, {p_lower:.6f}) = {tost_p:.6f}')
print()
print(f'bf16-only TOST (3 seeds, df=2): mean={mean:.2f}pp, SE={se:.2f}pp, TOST p={tost_p:.3f} at ±2pp, equivalent={equivalent}')
"
